important: These reference numbers are on the 450-task hidden-answer set (72 easy, 378 hard). Our numbers are on the 10-task public dev split (3 easy, 7 hard) whose answers are public. They are not comparable; they are listed only for orientation.

leaderboard.source: https://huggingface.co/spaces/adyen/DABstep (table values read from https://adyen-dabstep.hf.space/config, Space revision d4431c2e4a695cbe43c33aab2adaa304a37ae64a)
leaderboard.metric: Easy / Hard Level Accuracy (%) = mean official question_scorer score per level on all 450 tasks

validated_top.agent: NVIDIA KGMON (NeMo Agent Toolkit) Data Explorer

leaderboard.unvalidated_note: The unvalidated board has 17 entries at 100% hard accuracy, including entries named like 'test gold', so it says little about agent ability. The Space notes that validation requests are closed ahead of DABstep-v2; the validated board is the meaningful reference.

paper.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23719 (v1, 30 Jun 2025): Egg, Iglesias Goyanes, Kingma, Mora, von Werra, Wolf, 'DABstep: Data Agent Benchmark for Multi-step Reasoning'
paper.setup: smolagents code agents, max 10 steps per task (ReAct prompt; reasoning-prompt for o-series), 450 tasks: 72 easy, 378 hard
